description: This Java class implements the DefaultAuthenticationConfig, which provides configuration details for authentication in the Eclipse Ditto gateway, including proxy, DevOps, and OAuth settings.

classes.name: DefaultAuthenticationConfig
classes.description: Immutable class implementing AuthenticationConfig, encapsulating authentication-related configuration including enabling flags and nested config objects.
